author: Unity
description:
A complete automotive human-machine interface, built in Unity and running at 60 fps on a Raspberry Pi 5.

In this video, we walk through the four modules in the Industry HMI Template, Body Control, ADAS, Cluster and Climate, and look inside the Unity project at the modular scene setup, the ScriptableObject data layer, and the theme system.

Whether you're prototyping a cockpit, restyling an interface for a new brand, or plugging in real telemetry, the template gives you a working HMI to start from instead of an empty project and something you can deploy to constrained hardware and profile end to end.

🔗 Get started: https://on.unity.com/HMI
